issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite TDD requiring tests for every feature plus unauthorized and tamper tests for each Livewire action.
docs/database-schema.md is not updated even though the task explicitly requires reading and updating it for the new entities tables.

Livewire user input uses inline $this->validate([...]) without #[Validate] attributes on $email, $name, $slug, and no validation rules at all for $targetMembershipId, deviating from the required #[Validate] + $this->validate() pattern.
Domain writes (addMember, assignRole, removeMember, save, delete, transfer) are implemented directly in Livewire components instead of delegating to app/Actions/* per project conventions.
Adds unrelated CI files including an empty deploy-dev.yml that serve no task requirement.
Session clearing uses strict === between session value and model id, so a string/int mismatch would leave stale current_entity_id after entity deletion.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:93-95 inline $this->validate without #[Validate] on public string $email:81; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:93-97 same for $name/$slug/$targetMembershipId; no docs/ update; no app/Actions/* delegation; logging via Log::channel('audit') and #[Locked] Entity correct

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:114-161, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:236-271: small focused methods with clear names; empty .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:1 is dead content

requirements.evidence: Migrations cover entities_slug_unique, entity_memberships_entity_user_unique, owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_one_owner; policies match task; entity.pick audit log + redirect correct; dashboard @can manageSettings hides settings URL; Members/Settings cover duplicate-email, role in:admin,employee, last-manager 403, atomic transfer; missing docs/database-schema.md update

scope.evidence: Almost all hunks serve the task (models, policies, Livewire, routes, lang); exception is .github/workflows/tests.yml:1-11 and empty .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:1 which were not requested

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:45, Members.php:91/122/145, Settings.php:201/209/224/238 authorize every action; Members.php:118-122 and Settings.php:240-255 scope IDs to entity before authorizing; Blade uses {{ }} only; $fillable set in Entity.php:298 and EntityMembership.php:342; #[Locked] Entity prevents swap

simplicity.evidence: Direct Eloquent + policies with no service layers or speculative abstractions; minor indirection via Validator::make in Members.php:124-131 and two unrelated workflow files

tests.evidence: change.diff has zero tests/ hunks; only .github/workflows/tests.yml:20 runs tests in CI without adding any

review.summary: The change implements nearly the full entities data model, policies, entity picker, and Livewire pages correctly with solid authorization. It cannot be approved because it ships no tests, skips the required docs/database-schema.md update, and deviates from #[Validate] and Actions conventions.
